Request deletion of your Sideout data

To delete your Sideout account and associated live data, contact the Sideout operator using the steps below. Requests are handled manually after account ownership is verified.

Request steps

  1. Email hoyjoshi@gmail.com with the subject Sideout data deletion request.
  2. Include your Sideout player name and player code, if available, and say which sign-in provider you used. Send the request from the email associated with your Sideout account when possible. If you cannot access that email, explain that in the request.
  3. Ask for deletion of your Sideout account and associated identifying information, including your player profile and avatar, player code, court check-in, invitations and duo links, and identifying information held in duo and match records.
  4. The operator verifies that the request concerns your account before changing its data, then confirms the outcome and explains any information that could not be removed. Sending the email does not itself complete deletion.

Do not send your Facebook or Google password, login codes, access tokens, or a photo of an identity document. A request does not require you to share those items in email or chat.

Facebook access and Sideout data are separate

You can remove Sideout’s access through Facebook’s settings for connected apps. This disconnects the Facebook authorization; it does not by itself erase the profile, game records, or other data already stored by Sideout. Contact the Sideout operator separately using the request process above.

If you use more than one sign-in provider, identify the Sideout player account you want deleted. Removing one provider’s access does not establish that a different Sideout player account belongs to you.

Actions available now

Use Hide status & whereabouts in Friends to remove your shared whereabouts and Leave this duo to end your current duo membership. In Hosting, change your RSVP to release a confirmed spot or cancel an event you host. You can also edit your displayed name and character or sign out. These actions do not constitute full account deletion.

A shared or downloaded story card is a separate copy. Sideout cannot delete images that you or another person saved or posted on Instagram, Facebook, or another service; request removal there as needed.

What account deletion removes

The operator removes your live Sideout sign-in account, profile and pixel character, player code, rating totals, court check-in, invitations, duo links and associated duo records, event participation, and events you host. Removing a hosted event also removes its participant records for everyone. Affected match records and their saved character/name snapshots are removed for all participants. Other players’ current MMR, game totals and win totals are preserved.

The procedure covers live application data. Service-provider backups, security and audit logs, request correspondence, and images separately shared or downloaded are outside that live deletion operation. The operator will explain any applicable limits when confirming your request. Signing up again later creates a new account.
